info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Insights API
info.description: Provides API methods for insight and mover/shaker comparisons between report periods.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).
(Required) The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

request.description: Detects whether insights can be generated for this date/period combination or not.

response.name:
Whether a previous comparison period exists for the requested date/period combination.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

request.description: Detects the movers and shakers of a given date / report combination. A mover and shakers has an higher impact than other rows on average. For instance if a sites pageviews increase by 10% a page that increased by 40% at the same time contributed significantly more to the success than the average of 10%.

response.name:
Movers-and-shakers rows for the requested report.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.
